name: carrera-desktop
description: Standalone Windows app for Carrera Race Control (Electron shell around the Python backend)
author: Carrera Race Control

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json && node scripts/copy-assets.mjs && node scripts/check-env-schema.mjs
scripts.dev: npm run build && node scripts/ensure-frontend.mjs && electron .
scripts.dist: npm run build && npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend && npm run package
scripts.dist:x64: npm run build && npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend && node scripts/package.mjs --arch x64
scripts.dist:arm64: npm run build && npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend && node scripts/package.mjs --arch arm64
